meta.seoTitle: TIDE Foundation — Holistic Education for India
meta.seoDescription: TIDE Foundation works to bring sustainable, systemic change to India's education landscape through six independent projects.

hero.description: TIDE Foundation works to bring sustainable, systemic change to India's education landscape through six independent projects — built to last, designed to disappear.

mission.title: Education as the silver bullet
mission.body: Access to quality education is the key to unlocking India's social challenges. We work intensively with communities — not superficially across many — to build change that grows from within.
mission.quote: A sustainable change requires deep understanding of the complex system.

programs.sectionSubtitle: Each initiative targets a different root cause in the education system, working independently toward the same north star.

items.title: Block ETI
items.desc: Systemic change at the block level — transforming foundational learning across rural Gujarat.

items.title: BetterED
items.desc: After-school life-skills and numeracy programs across 12 urban slum communities.

items.title: EmpowerEd
items.desc: Bottom-up professional development — teachers as agents of change, not recipients.

items.title: CompletEd
items.desc: Social justice through civic education — fellowships, SDG drives, Model City Councils.

items.title: THRIvE
items.desc: A research centre for transformative, inclusive and equitable education futures.

items.title: Other Projects
items.desc: College development, refugee education, Disha, Saral Kadam and beyond.

testimonial.quote: TIDE doesn't just run programs — it builds ecosystems. Their work with our teachers changed how our entire school thinks about education.
testimonial.author: School Principal, Ahmedabad

cta.body: Whether you donate time, resources, or expertise — there's a place for you in TIDE's mission.
